caption.text:
After 8 months of planning & 4 months figuring out Costa Rican importing, my solar array has finally arrived at the homestead. 

Four 15 kwh Nexus batteries & three 10 kw Apex inverters, which will give me around 130 amps AC output @ 230v & drink up to 33,000 watts of solar an hour. 

Can’t wait to show you what I mean when I say OG really stands for off grid 🇨🇷☀️😎 #joefelz #solar #offgrid #homestead #working
